text:
samir (Product): Quick design huddle: final pass on Autoscale modal copy + interaction. Figma: https://figma.redwood/autoscale-final. Focus areas: SLO phrasing, on-demand capacity wording, keyboard behavior, and the cost guardrail banner. Please drop quick takes.
ana (Design): thinking: rename 'Burst' to 'On-demand capacity' (less slang-y). Inline helper: 'Adds GPUs for short spikes; billed while active.' Keep a short one-line under SLO slider: 'Target p50 latency — lower values increase capacity and cost.'
jon (Frontend): keyboard/interaction notes: slider: arrow +/-1, PageUp/PageDown +/-10, Home/End to min/max. Double-click numeric value to edit. While dragging, update the numeric readout but dont call preview API until release or 300ms pause. We'll expose aria-valuetext like 'SLO target: 120 milliseconds'.
leah (Engineering): debounce 300ms for preview calls, but no backend call on transient drag unless user releases. Cost preview endpoint should accept vector of changes to batch multiple fields. Guardrail: if change increases expected daily instance-hours > 2x, show soft-warning banner. Block only on quota or safety limits.
ana (Design): microcopy for guardrail banner: 'Estimated cost increase: high. This configuration may significantly raise daily instance-hours.' CTA: 'View estimate'. Also add small inline pill next to aggressive presets: 'High cost'.
jon (Frontend): a11y: slider must use role=slider + aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow and aria-live to announce updates. Tooltips should be keyboard focusable (tabbable) and visible on focus. For autoscale toggle, if min/max become managed show helper text: 'Managed by autoscale' and ensure aria-describedby points to it.
ops-bot: Accessibility reminder: run axe in storybook & include keyboard-only screenshots in PR. Also include label contrast checks for preset pills.
leah (Engineering): technical: implementing a cost preview mini-chart in the modal (sparkline) requires a small API change but is doable. We should show an approximate number next to the Apply button when preview available.
samir (Product): decision summary: 1) Use 'On-demand capacity' terminology, 2) keep SLO microcopy as above, 3) debounce 300ms + no-preview during active drag, 4) soft-warning banner for >2x instance-hours, 5) show disabled 'Save as pool default' toggle (tooltip: coming soon). Any objections?
ana (Design): none. I'll update Figma and add hover/copy states.
jon (Frontend): will implement keyboard + aria behaviors, tabbable tooltips, and aria-live announcements. Adding e2e keyboard tests.
leah (Engineering): will expose batched preview API and add quota checks for blocking errors.
samir (Product): action items: Ana update copy by EOD, Jon wire interactions, Leah scope API. We'll do a quick dev review Friday. Thanks! :tada:
